diagnosis.root_cause: logical_dump excluded the other wall-clock columns but retained trace_run.captured_at; the schema default uses datetime('now'), so sequential fresh seeds differ whenever their inserts cross a SQLite second boundary.
diagnosis.order_effect: No order-dependent seed state was found. The isolated and initial full-suite runs completed within one SQLite second and passed; the full-suite run changes the timing window and exposed the latent race. A 1.05-second delay between fresh seed writes deterministically reproduced the two-row mismatch.
diagnosis.reproduction: Seed one fresh build-agnostic database, wait 1.05 seconds, seed a second fresh database, then compare logical_dump results.

fix.change: Exclude trace_run.captured_at from logical_dump and add a regression test that changes only captured_at in one fresh database and requires equal logical dumps.
fix.scope: Test infrastructure only; seed, schema, gameplay, renderer, assets, triage, xrefs, and campaign data were not changed.
